# @elementor/oidc-auth

OAuth/OIDC auth library with support for standard (single-window) and cross-window flows. Built on `oidc-client-ts`.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @elementor/oidc-auth
```

## Usage

Configure and use the library for either same-window or cross-window token delivery. (API details TBD.)

## Development

```bash
npm ci
npm run build
```
